notes.title: 0.7.2 Multiplayer Update & More!
notes.content:
Multiplayer has been updated! Up to 8 rocket ski racers from down the street or across the internet can now find out who is the fastest. With speeds boosting after every lap do you have what it takes to hold the fast line and finish first? Be sure to leave feedback in the discussion forum. 

I added a control tutorial. This will let you do some practice laps. I also added the ability to restart any of the tutorials. With any new game controls can sometimes be hard to get use to. Hopefully this helps! 

Finally, keyboard support has been added. It's not recommended, but if you really want use the keyboard you can. You're a better pilot than I ;)

notes.title: 0.6.4 - Multiplayer is Live!
notes.content:
Multiplayer is here! You can now put your skills to the test against rocket ski racers down the street or across the internet. With speeds boosting after every lap do you have what it takes to hold the fast line after 20 laps?!

Be sure to leave feedback on the discussion forums! 

Cheers!

Jared

notes.title: EA Launch!
notes.content:
Just wanted to say THANKS to everyone who has purchased the game! If you like the game please tell a friend or make a youtube video and help spread the word!

On the multiplayer side, I believe I've found a good replacement for the current networking API. If things go well multiplayer will be out sooner rather than later.

Cheers!

Jared

notes.title: 0.5.1 Uploaded
notes.content:
0.5.1 went a little faster than anticipated and has been uploaded to steam. The main additions were in-game music, achievements and leaderboards. For a full list of changes please see the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/471730/discussions/0/351659808482379482/]changelog[/url]. 

Between now and launch I'll be doing some bug fixes. These will make it into a 0.5.x build which should be available by launch.
